# Far conveying runs the family down

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`far-conveying-runs-the-family-down` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](far-conveying-runs-the-family-down.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Balanced and dissipated on across N steps, each conveying from a member of the family, the family's stock falls by at least N; so from a stock of S at most S stages are conveyed.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A step conveying from a member of a family has a formation taking from the family; balanced and dissipated on across N such steps, the family's stock falls by at least N, and N is at most its stock at the start. (`Becoming.Flow.takers_pos_of_conveys`, `Becoming.Flow.conveyed_loses`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; balance and dissipation on the family at each step of the stretch; whole-number amounts.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That actual supply lines dissipate at each stage.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
